Methodologically, the work forms part of the complex combinatorial framework of the *Paṭṭhāna*, analyzing the relational conditions between phenomena classified according to the triad of clinging or grasped dhammas (*upādinnattika*) combined with the dyad of root conditions (*hetuduka*).
